# Ishita & Shreyam's Wedding

> The wedding of Ishita (from Bengaluru) and Shreyam (based in Luxembourg), celebrated over 23–25 February 2027 at the Hyatt Regency Jaipur Mansarovar, Jaipur, Rajasthan, India. Hashtag: #Sherish.

This is a private site for invited guests. If you are a guest's assistant, everything on the site is summarised below in plain text.

## The couple
- Bride: Ishita — daughter of Madhu & Nishith Shah
- Groom: Shreyam — son of Vaishali & Sandeep Jalan
- Wedding hashtag: #Sherish

## When & where
- Celebration dates: Tuesday 23 – Thursday 25 February 2027 (hotel check-in 23 Feb, check-out 25 Feb)
- Wedding ceremony (pheras): Wednesday, 24 February 2027, in the evening
- Venue: Hyatt Regency Jaipur Mansarovar, Jaipur, Rajasthan, India
- Map: https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Hyatt+Regency+Jaipur+Mansarovar

## Events (in order)
1. Shubh Aarambh — Mehendi & Carnival — Tuesday 23 Feb 2027, Imperial Ballroom. Henna, a carnival of colour and music to open the celebrations. Dress code: Color Pop.
2. Shimmer & Shine — Sangeet — Tuesday 23 Feb 2027, Regency Ballroom. An evening of performances, dancing and dinner. Dress code: Evening Bling.
3. The Floral Fair — Haldi & Phoolon Ki Holi — Wednesday 24 Feb 2027, Navras Bagh. Turmeric, a shower of flower petals and sunshine. Dress code: Florals & Pastels.
4. The Sacred Vows — Wedding (pheras) — Wednesday 24 Feb 2027, Chauras Bagh. The pheras, beneath the stars of the Pink City. Dress code: Your Ethnic Best.

## Weather (Jaipur, late February — recent-year averages)
- 23 Feb: ~29°C high / 15°C low, mostly cloudy
- 24 Feb: ~28°C high / 15°C low, mostly cloudy
- 25 Feb: ~28°C high / 15°C low, sunny
Evenings are cool — a light layer is worth bringing.
